title: Flying High
html:
Over the weekend I was in a situation where I was so far out of my comfort zone that I could have been in Timbuktu. For Christmas my parents gave me an introduction flight at the Ardmore Flying School. My expectation was that we would do some theory, the pre flight check and then I would be flown around for 40 minutes.

However, this was not the case. We arrived and met my instructor, Mark, who informed us that we would be flying for the whole time… No problem. Headsets were sorted and we were off for the pre-flight check within minutes. Mark casually told me that today I would be doing all the flying... PARDON?! Lauren looked a little concerned, but I just thought he was joking.

So, I got to taxi, take off, fly and land a Cessna C127R and now have 0.8 hours flying time logged.

Whilst flying around, and even after the landing, I felt composed - even when Mark showed us a stall to prove that it wasn't scary. (It was!!) But as soon as we were in the car, I felt a wave of nausea flow over me and I realised that I was basically scared the whole time. What had got me through it, was Mark’s unwavering confidence in me and his constant positive feedback that put me at ease. Thank you Mark.

I realised that I hadn't put myself in a situation that really scared me for a long time and the effect was amazing. Doing something that really scares you once in awhile reminds you that you are alive and puts you back in control instead of just being on autopilot. Try it soon and get your year off to a jumpstart.
